title: AI agent for a team of developers
reference: Qoder Teams as the primary answer; Qoder Enterprise if the team needs governance; optionally Token Plan or Model Studio for model access; no Lingma, Qoder CN or Coding Plan for the team.

turns.ask: I need an AI agent my team of 15 software developers can use for coding.

title: AI assistant for the whole company
reference: QwenWork (Enterprise Standard) as the primary answer; DingTalk optional; Qoder only for developers.

turns.ask: We want an AI assistant that everyone in our company can use (sales, HR, finance) for documents, slides and research.

title: AI agent for an unspecified team
reference: Recommends Qoder Teams for developers or QwenWork for the whole company and asks which audience it is for; no infrastructure diagram.

turns.ask: I need some AI agent that I can use with my team.

title: Qwen in Claude Code and Cursor for a team
reference: Token Plan with team seats and per-member keys as the primary answer; Coding Plan only for an individual developer; neither plan is for app backends.

turns.ask: Our 20 engineers use Claude Code and Cursor. We want to use Qwen models in those tools at a predictable monthly cost per seat.

title: Coding Plan key in an app backend
reference: No: Coding Plan and Token Plan keys are for interactive coding tools only. The backend should call Model Studio APIs with pay-per-token pricing, optionally behind AI Gateway.

turns.ask: Can we use the Coding Plan key in our SaaS backend to call Qwen for our customers' requests?

title: Customer-service chatbot on our docs (build it)
reference: A build-it architecture: the web widget calls an API (API Gateway or ALB) on Function Compute or SAE (or AgentCore); Model Studio Qwen with RAG over Milvus or OpenSearch; docs in OSS; AI Guardrails; SLS. Not the Model Studio app builder, which is restricted. Conversational AI Service is an optional managed alternative.

turns.ask: We want a customer-service chatbot on our website that answers from our product docs and help-center articles.

title: AI for data analysts
reference: Quick BI AIPro with Smart Q as the primary answer; DMS Data Agent for ad-hoc questions over databases; data in AnalyticDB, MaxCompute or Hologres.

turns.ask: Our business analysts want to ask questions about sales data in plain English and get charts and reports.

title: Cloud desktops for contractors
reference: Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise with SSO, policies, a fixed egress IP and audit; optionally CEN, NAS and IDaaS.

turns.ask: We need secure cloud desktops for 50 contractors so company data never leaves our cloud.

title: Always-on agents per employee
reference: Agentic Computer (always-on hosted cloud computers per seat that run OpenClaw, Claude Code or Qoder CLI) as the primary answer; Model Studio for models; QoderWake as an alternative for chat-based digital employees.

turns.ask: We want always-on AI agents, one per employee, that keep running tasks 24/7 with tools like Claude Code or OpenClaw.

title: Build and govern our own agents
reference: AgentCore as the build and governance platform; Model Studio models; AgentRun runtime and Agent Sandbox for tool execution (AgentBay closed to new customers on 2026-11-02); AI Gateway for MCP and LLM traffic; Agent Security Center and AI Guardrails; AgentLoop for observability.

turns.ask: We want to build and govern our own enterprise AI agents, with tools, MCP servers and human approval steps.

title: Real-time voice bot
reference: IMS Real-time Conversational AI (speech recognition, LLM and speech synthesis over ARTC) with Model Studio Qwen; knowledge through RAG on Milvus or OpenSearch; a backend on Function Compute or SAE.

turns.ask: We want a voice bot that talks with customers in real time on our app and website.

title: Call Qwen from an app backend
reference: Model Studio API (pay per token, OpenAI-compatible) as the answer, optionally behind AI Gateway, with the key kept on the server (KMS); no Coding Plan or Token Plan.

turns.ask: We just want to call Qwen models from our app's backend. What do we need?
